verdict.rationale: Ramp's Banking API docs say a business can hold more than one Checking Account (WALLET_ACCOUNT), so multiple checking accounts are a documented capability. Nothing in the pack shows rules that automatically split incoming deposits across those accounts. The auto top-up and target-balance feature is a related but different control: it funds Ramp from linked checking accounts and does not allocate deposits. missing for 10: documented sub-account creation workflow, auto-allocation rules for incoming deposits, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a finance-lead, I can open multiple checking sub-accounts and auto-allocate incoming deposits across them
